args.summary: Deployment v2.3.1 of checkout-api failed production health checks. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification: service reports healthy=true with error_rate=0.002. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure requires investigation; recommend postmortem and fix before re-deploying.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: the service now reports healthy with an error rate of 0.002.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback action, and the healthy post-rollback state. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so re-deploying it (or any fixed version) will require change-manager approval per policy — worth including in the postmortem follow-up.
